observations.description: PREFLIGHT_ONLY is the default mode. -Execute switch is required for physical restart. PREFLIGHT_ONLY exits before Stop-ScheduledTask. Mode field distinguishes PREFLIGHT_ONLY from EXECUTE.
Only BTC task (BTC Public Candle Research Recorder) is stopped and started. ES-NQ Delayed Daily Research Collector is never stopped, started, disabled, enabled, registered, or unregistered.

Preflight requires BTC Running, exact action arguments (-NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass), working directory, IgnoreNew single-instance, single action, fresh poll (<90s), RECORDING manifest, zero gaps.
Preflight requires ES/NQ Ready, last result 0, no missed runs, healthy state, trading=false.
Restart is bounded: Stop-ScheduledTask, 30-second stop deadline, recovery timeout 60-600s (default 180), BTC state polled.
Recovery requires a genuinely newer healthy BTC poll (postTime > prePollTime). BTC must be Running after recovery.
Recovery rejects new unresolved BTC gaps: postGapCount must equal preGapCount.
ES/NQ state, last result, last run time, and evidence hash must remain unchanged. Any change rejects with 'ES/NQ collector changed during BTC-only recovery drill'.
Failure evidence is retained (RECOVERY_FAILED, failure_reason). Automatic BTC restart attempted (Start-ScheduledTask $btcTaskName in catch). Failure rethrows after writing report.

Evidence is repository-contained (path containment check), atomic (WriteAllText+Move-Item), content-addressed (SHA256 report_id), sanitized (no credentials), trading_authority=false, es_nq_collector_operated=false.
PREFLIGHT_ONLY does not claim physical restart: physical_recorder_restart_claimed=false is set before preflight exit. The $true assignment is only after successful recovery, after the preflight exit.
No provider SDK, no signing, no exchange, no order-submission (place_order, submit_live, submit_order, send_order).
No live or paper order submission: no live_order, paper_gateway, paper_exchange references.
PowerShell: requires 5.1, CmdletBinding, ErrorActionPreference=Stop, OutputPath parameter.
Report schema: controlled-btc-recorder-recovery-drill-v1, started_at, completed_at, result (PREFLIGHT_VERIFIED/RECOVERY_VERIFIED), mode, trading_authority=false.

redundant: Some adversarial tests overlap with existing on preflight default, BTC-only control, bounded recovery, failure evidence, no credentials
